name: kanban
title: Kanban
description: A board of columns whose items are moved within a column or into another, by dragging, with the keys or by choosing a place.
use: Work that passes through a few stages: tasks, candidates, orders, requests. Each column is a named section with a list; each item has a handle and a button that opens the mover, both named with what they move. What an item shows is a card, a badge or an avatar of the page's own.

instead.when: One list is put in order and nothing changes column
The stages are only read, and nothing is moved
The work is laid out against time

keyboard.action: On a handle, pick the item up; again, drop it in the place chosen
Choose the place before or after, in the column the item would land in
Choose the column beside it, as it is seen: the other way around from right to left. The place stays, or is the column's last when it has fewer
Choose the first or the last place of that column
Leave the item where it was and keep focus on its handle; during a drag, end the drag
Drop the item in the place chosen, then leave the handle as Tab does

platform.feature: The popover API, for the carried item's name in the top layer
platform.fallback: Nothing follows the pointer: the item fades in its place and the line marks where it would land
The item is inserted again, and what had focus in it is focused again

platform.feature: Element.startViewTransition() with view-transition-name: match-element, for the items' way to their new places
platform.fallback: The items take their new places at once

platform.feature: :has(), for the carried item and the empty column
platform.fallback: The carried item does not fade and an empty column shows no well; the line still marks the place

classes.name: kanban
classes.description: The board: a row of columns that scrolls across. Give it a height and its columns stop there, each list scrolling by itself. While an item is carried the cursor is a closed hand

classes.name: kanban-column
classes.description: A column, a tray named by its title. It stands for its data-value. With hidden it takes no item and is passed over

classes.name: kanban-header
classes.description: The head of a column: its title and whatever stands beside it, such as a count. It stays while the list scrolls

classes.name: kanban-title
classes.description: The column's name, on the line the items' words start on

classes.name: kanban-items
classes.description: The list of a column, in the order of the document. It is the part that scrolls

classes.name: kanban-items-target
classes.description: Set by the behavior on the list whose end is the place the carried item would land in: a line after its last item, or a ring around the well of an empty column

classes.name: kanban-item
classes.description: An item. It stands for its data-value, which no other item of the board has. Carried, it keeps its place and fades. A mouse carries it by any part that is not a link, a button or a field

classes.name: kanban-item-target
classes.description: Set by the behavior on the item the carried one would land before: a line in the gap over it

classes.name: kanban-handle
classes.description: The grip that carries the item: name it with what it moves. A 24px target, 44px tall on touch screens, that stops halfway to the move button beside it

classes.name: kanban-controls
classes.description: What holds an item's move button and its handle as a pair at the end of its first line: they stand close, hang into the item's padding so the grip's glyph meets the edge the words under it end on, and center on a line of --kanban-line

classes.name: kanban-move
classes.description: The button that opens the mover for its item, drawn as the grip's pair: two arrows that pass, in a 24px target, 44px tall on touch screens, that stops halfway to the grip. Give it the popovertarget of the mover's popover and name it with what it moves. Where a pointer hovers it is drawn once the pointer or the keys are on its item

classes.name: kanban-empty
classes.description: A few words in a shallow well, shown in place of the list while the column holds no item

classes.name: kanban-preview
classes.description: An empty element the behavior shows in the top layer during a drag, with the carried item's name, at the pointer

classes.name: kanban-preview-landing
classes.description: Set by the behavior after the release, while the sheet glides to the place the item took

classes.name: kanban-mover
classes.description: The form of a popover in the board, with a select named column and a select named position, which the behavior fills. A button in an item whose popovertarget is that popover, kanban-move or one of the page's own, opens it for the item; submitting it moves the item. The behavior gives the form that button's name as its aria-label, so it says which item it moves

classes.name: kanban-mover-actions
classes.description: The mover's buttons, at its end: the one that closes it, then the one that moves

classes.name: kanban-status
classes.description: A region that says each pick, place, drop and cancel, inside the board or right after it. It takes no room

states.name: carried
states.description: The item is picked up, by the pointer or the keys: the grip sits in a well and the item fades in its place

states.name: disabled
states.description: The item stays where it is: the pointer, the keys and the mover all leave it

states.name: hidden
states.description: The column is not shown and takes no item

properties.name: --kanban-column-width
properties.description: The width of a column, which is never wider than the board less 2rem

properties.name: --kanban-inset
properties.description: The room between a column's edge and its items; the column's corner is the items' corner plus it

properties.name: --kanban-item-gap
properties.description: The room between two items, where the line of a place stands

properties.name: --kanban-padding
properties.description: The padding of a card the board holds; a column's title starts on the same line

properties.name: --kanban-radius
properties.description: The corner of a card the board holds, of an empty column's well and of the carried sheet

properties.name: --kanban-marker
properties.description: The ink of the line, and of the ring around an empty column, that marks a place

properties.name: --kanban-line
properties.description: The height of the line the pair of controls centers on: a card title's by default

properties.name: --kanban-x
properties.description: Where the carried sheet's start edge is, from the viewport's left; the script writes it

properties.name: --kanban-y
properties.description: Where the carried sheet's top is, from the viewport's top; the script writes it

properties.name: --kanban-width
properties.description: The width of the carried sheet, the carried item's own; the script writes it
